text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
“Ah! Could this encounter truly be destiny...!
O brave knight, hear my lament!”

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Moisture for my throat!
An unknown drop for my heart!
Grant me a mocktail born from the outside world!!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Wh-What do you mean...?
Born in the outside world... in another world? Um...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Does that mean you wish to drink a mocktail crafted by someone else?
...If you are fine with me, I would be happy to serve you.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"Thank you for your chivalrous kindness.
Now then—a mocktail of 'Blessing.'"

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
A-A 'Blessing'...!?
Understood. A knight never goes back on her word.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: (Still, what flavor is a "blessing"...? Sweet, since it's a celebration? That might be too simple, though.)

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
...The chains of logic are useless.
Now is the time to unleash yourself.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
(Unleash myself... meaning, just do it freely?
Then, the image I have is—!)

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: That glorious moment when you return from an adventure and receive praise from your master!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
No matter how many hardships arise...
As long as I have words of praise bestowed by the "King"!
Any struggle will be worth it!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Truly, the supreme joy of a knight! There could be no greater "blessing" than this!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
First, a fiery red reminiscent of a fierce
journey... Tomato juice, please!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
And then, to symbolize glory,
we mix in some sparkling ginger ale...!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Its name, indeed... is the 'Triumph of the Valkyrie'.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"Here is your non-alcoholic cocktail...
Please, enjoy."

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: ...Magnificent! Such a grand flavor—truly an epic poem for the palate! I can almost hear the triumphal song dedicated to the knight!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: I'm impressed! To think such an incredible storyteller existed!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: ...I am honored by your praise.
Perhaps inspired by making the mocktail, Durandal's senses grew even sharper from that day forward.
